title: cotula lineariloba
intro: Cotula lineariloba, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Burreed or Cotula, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in relieving digestive issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cotula lineariloba include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant are primarily sesquiterpenoids and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
